purpose.summary: This subprogram retrieves the online receipt print program name and output destination printer name for the ORCA (JMA standard medical receipt) system. Given a classification code and inpatient/outpatient flag, it resolves the appropriate print program name (e.g., ORCHC01, ORCHCN01) either from system management master data or defaults. It is part of the Japan Medical Association open-source medical billing software.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese medical receipt processing)

D-level debug DISPLAY lines (conditional debug output)
COPY directives for multiple .INC copybooks (CPSK1031, CPSK1032, CPSK1034, CPSK1035, CPORCSPRTNM, etc.)
CALL to 'coblog' for error logging (GnuCOBOL runtime convention)
STRING ... DELIMITED BY SIZE/SPACE ... INTO ... END-STRING
LINKAGE SECTION with three passed areas (parameter, SPA, SYSKANRI)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: The source file is genuine COBOL from the ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) open-source project, a well-known Japanese medical billing system. Comments are in Japanese encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, which appear garbled when decoded as latin-1. The program is a subprogram (called via CALL/USING) that maps classification codes to print program names for both inpatient and outpatient contexts. The 'D' prefix on DISPLAY lines is a standard GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL debug-line convention. Source was truncated at 16000 chars but enough is visible to classify confidently.
